about_the_game:
ATTENTION! This is the Director speaking.

Welcome cadets and kittens to Insanitation. Here at CSP you will fight and strive to create Order or Chaos by any means necessary. No kibble too dry and no mop too wet. 

Battle in a head to head competition against up to 4 family members or friends where it's Cats VS Keepers. You decide the difficulty as you battle your way through houses and restaurants alike.

Fight clean, play dirty!

Create Order As A Keeper :

As an agent of ORDER your task is to keep the area assigned to you as neat and tidy as it was built and designed ( if you can ).

Create Chaos As A Cat :

As an agent of CHAOS your task is to keep the area assigned to you as disgustingly dirty as possible, wreaking havoc wherever your paws take you.

Clean Or Destroy 3 Crazy Chaotically Fun Maps

Each map has been designed to offer a new challenge to face or create. Ranging from a Crazy Cat Lady's Apartment, or an "average" Home Insanitation has it all.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends. Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over? Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.
